description: This source file provides a utility function `_simple_graph_snapshot_restoration` for fast-forwarding and restoring the state of a data pipeline represented by `IterDataPipe`. It includes implementation details, comments for usage caveats, and dependencies on other modules within the PyTorch DataLoader's datapipes infrastructure.

classes.name: _SnapshotState
classes.description: An enumeration class that tracks the snapshot state of the DataPipe, e.g., whether it has been restored or is currently iterating.

methods.name: None _simple_graph_snapshot_restoration( datapipe: IterDataPipe, n_iterations: int, rng=None )
methods.description: Restores the position of a DataPipe to a previous state by fast-forwarding it through a specified number of iterations. It resets the DataPipe, applies a provided random seed generator if available, and iterates forward, updating internal state to allow for efficient restart in data pipelines.
